introduction.zh: 夜里，鹦鹉波利尼西亚悄悄从树后溜出去，飞到牢房窗边。她压低声音告诉杜立德医生一件事，还要他先让对方许下一个承诺。医生听完，为什么直摇头？
introduction.en: Late at night the parrot Polynesia slips away to the prison window. She wakes the Doctor with a plan, but he must first make the Prince promise something. Why does the Doctor shake his head?

sentences: 波利尼西亚非常非常轻地溜到树后，确认没有人会看见她，然后飞过夜空，到了牢房那边。

hints.zh: 波利尼西亚，那只鹦鹉；她一直替医生出主意。
hints.en: Polynesia, the parrot, who is always full of plans.

sentences: 她发现咕咕正把鼻子从窗栏缝里伸出去，想闻从王宫厨房飘来的饭菜香味。
她让这头小猪把医生带到窗边来，因为她有话要跟他说。
于是咕咕走过去，叫醒了正在打盹的医生。

hints.zh: 咕咕，医生的宠物小猪。
hints.en: Gub-Gub, the Doctor's little pig.

sentences: 「听着，」约翰·杜立德的脸一出现在窗口，鹦鹉就小声说，「邦波王子今晚要到这里来看你。
你得想个办法，把他变成白人。
不过你一定要先让他答应你：他会打开牢门，再给你找一条能渡海的船。」

hints.zh: 约翰·杜立德，就是杜立德医生；鹦鹉叫他的全名。
hints.en: John Dolittle, the Doctor himself; the parrot uses his full name.

hints.zh: 邦波王子，乔利金基国王的儿子。
hints.en: Prince Bumpo, the son of the King of Jolliginki.

sentences: 「这话倒是不错，」医生说。
「可把一个黑人变成白人，没那么容易。
你说得好像他是一件可以重新染色的衣服。
事情没这么简单。你知道的，『豹子岂能改变斑点，埃塞俄比亚人岂能改变肤色』？」

hints.zh: 埃塞俄比亚人；医生引的是《圣经》里的老话，意思是本性难移。
hints.en: An Ethiopian; the Doctor quotes an old Bible saying about how no one can change his nature.

sentences: 「那些我都不懂，」波利尼西亚不耐烦地说。
「可你必须把这个黑人变成白人。
想个办法——好好想。
你袋子里还剩着好多药呢。
只要你改了他的颜色，他什么都肯为你做。
这是你逃出牢房的唯一机会。」

hints.zh: 旧时对黑人的蔑称，粗鲁且带侮辱；今天这样说会冒犯别人。
hints.en: An old, insulting word for a Black man. It was used casually in the book's time, but it is offensive and is not used today.

quiz.question: What does Polynesia say the Doctor must do to Prince Bumpo?
options: Find some way to turn him white
Send him back to his father
Teach him to speak to animals

feedback.zh: 鹦鹉明确说「你得想个办法，把他变成白人」，这是她半夜飞来的目的。
feedback.en: The parrot says straight out: you must find some way to turn him white.

quiz.question: What must the Doctor make the Prince promise before anything else?
options: To open the prison-door and find a ship for him
To give him half of the kingdom
To keep the whole plan a secret from the King

feedback.zh: 波利尼西亚叮嘱他先要这个承诺：打开牢门，再找一条渡海的船。半个王国是王子自己后来提出的。
feedback.en: Polynesia tells him to get the promise first: the prison-door open and a ship to cross the sea. The half kingdom is the Prince's own offer, made later.

grammar.excerpt: you’ve got to find some way to turn him white

focus.zh: you’ve got to 是口语的「必须、非做不可」，比 must 更像在说没有别的路；后面跟动词原形 find。
focus.en: You’ve got to means you must, with no other way out; it takes the base verb find.

introduction.zh: 那天深夜，邦波王子真的悄悄来到牢房。他讲起自己寻找睡美人的经历，还许下半个王国作报酬。杜立德医生听完，先提了一个只改头发颜色的小提议——这能行吗？
introduction.en: That night Prince Bumpo comes secretly to the prison and tells the Doctor his story about the Sleeping Beauty. He offers half a kingdom. The Doctor makes one small, strange offer of his own: what if only the hair changed colour?

sentences: 「嗯，我想这也许办得到，」医生说。
「让我看看——」他走到药袋旁，嘴里咕哝着『用游离氯作用于动物色素——也许可以用锌软膏，作为临时办法，厚厚地涂一层——』

hints.zh: 锌软膏，一种外用药膏；医生念的这一串是化学名词，听着很唬人。
hints.en: Zinc ointment, a real skin medicine. The Doctor is muttering chemical-sounding words that impress his patient.

sentences: 那天夜里，邦波王子果然悄悄来到牢房，对医生说：
「白人，我是一个不快乐的王子。
很多年前，我去寻找睡美人——我是在一本书里读到她的。
我在世上走了许多天，终于找到了她，轻轻地吻了这位小姐，把她唤醒——就像书里说的那样。她确实醒了。
可她一看见我的脸就喊起来：『哦，他是黑人！』
她跑掉了，不肯嫁给我——又到别的地方睡过去了。
于是我满心悲伤，回到我父亲的王国。
现在我听说你是一位了不起的魔法师，有许多法力强大的药水。
所以我来求你帮忙。
如果你能把我变成白人，让我可以回到睡美人身边，我就把半个王国给你，另外你要什么都可以。」

hints.zh: 白人；邦波这样称呼医生，是他对远方来客的叫法。
hints.en: “White Man”: how Bumpo addresses the Doctor.

hints.zh: 睡美人，那个被吻醒就会醒来的公主。
hints.en: The Sleeping Beauty, the princess who wakes when she is kissed.

hints.zh: ’Tis 是 it is 的旧写法；王子说话带着古书的味道。
hints.en: ’Tis is an old way of saying “it is”, which suits the Prince's bookish way of talking.

hints.zh: 药水、汤剂；在童话里常指有魔力的药。
hints.en: Potions: liquid medicines, the magic kind in a fairy tale.

sentences: 「邦波王子，」医生若有所思地看着药袋里的瓶子说，「假如我把你的头发变成好看的金黄色——这样就不能让你高兴了吗？」

quiz.question: Why does Prince Bumpo come to the Doctor?
options: He wants the Doctor to turn him white
He wants medicine for his sick father
He wants to buy the Doctor's medicine-bag

feedback.zh: 王子承诺：只要医生把他变成白人，他就给半个王国。「白人」是他一路说下来最在意的事。
feedback.en: The Prince promises half his kingdom if the Doctor will turn him white — being white is all he cares about.

quiz.question: What does the Doctor suggest instead of turning him white?
options: Making his hair a nice blonde colour
Giving him a new suit of clothes
Making his eyes blue for him

feedback.zh: 医生先退一步，提出只把头发改成金黄色，问他这样能不能让他高兴。蓝眼睛是王子自己后来提的。
feedback.en: The Doctor first offers something smaller: nice blonde hair. The blue eyes are Bumpo's own idea, raised later.

grammar.excerpt: The Sleeping Beauty, whom I had read of in a book

focus.zh: whom 指前面的 the Sleeping Beauty，在从句里作 read of 的宾语；介词 of 留在从句末尾。
focus.en: Whom stands for the Sleeping Beauty and is the object of read of; the preposition of stays at the end of the clause.

introduction.zh: 王子不要金发，只要一张白脸，还顺带想要一双蓝眼睛。杜立德医生叹了口气，没有立刻动手：要试，得先谈好一条备好食物的船，和一句以王冠起的誓。
introduction.en: The Prince does not want golden hair; he wants a white face, and blue eyes as well. The Doctor sighs. Before he tries anything, he wants two things settled: a ship stocked with food, and an oath sworn on the crown.

sentences: 「不行，」邦波说。
「别的都不能让我满意。
我必须做一个白人王子。」
「你知道，要改变一个王子的肤色是很难的，」医生说，「这是魔法师最难办到的事情之一。
你只想要脸变白，对不对？」
「对，就这些，」邦波说。
「因为我要穿上发亮的盔甲，戴上钢护手，像别的白人王子那样，骑在马上。」

hints.zh: 钢制护手，骑士盔甲里护住手和手腕的那一部分。
hints.en: Gauntlets of steel: the armoured gloves that cover a knight's hands and wrists.

sentences: 「你的脸必须整张都变白吗？」医生问。
「对，整张都要白，」邦波说，「我还希望眼睛也是蓝的，不过我想那大概很难办到。」

hints.zh: all over 指「整张、到处」，这里说整张脸都要白。
hints.en: All over means “every part”: the whole face, not just one place.

sentences: 「是的，很难，」医生赶快说。
「好吧，我尽力替你想办法。
不过你得非常有耐心——你知道，用某些药，谁也说不准。
我可能要试上两三次。
你的皮肤很结实——是不是？
那就好。
现在到亮处来——哦，不过在我动手之前，你得先到海边去，准备一条船，船上备好食物，送我渡海。
这件事一个字也不许跟别人说。
等我照你的要求做完了，你就得放我跟我所有的动物出牢房。
发誓——以乔利金基的王冠发誓！」

hints.zh: 乔利金基，邦波父亲的王国，医生一行就被关在这里；以王冠起誓是他们最重的誓言。
hints.en: Jolliginki, the kingdom of Bumpo's father, where the Doctor is locked up. Swearing by its crown is the strongest promise there is.

quiz.question: What does the Prince say when the Doctor offers to change his hair?
options: Nothing else will satisfy him
He agrees to try it first
He asks for a beard as well

feedback.zh: 他一口回绝：「别的都不能让我满意，我必须做一个白人王子。」
feedback.en: He refuses at once: nothing else will satisfy him — he must be a white prince.

quiz.question: What must happen before the Doctor will begin?
options: A ship with food must be ready at the beach
The King must say yes to the plan
Bumpo must bring the crown to the prison

feedback.zh: 医生的条件是：先备好一条带食物的船，事成之后还要放他和动物们出牢房。
feedback.en: The Doctor's terms: a ship with food ready first, and after the job, freedom for himself and all his animals.

grammar.excerpt: one of the hardest things a magician can do

focus.zh: the hardest 是最高级；things 后面省掉了关系代词，a magician can do 直接修饰 things。
focus.en: The hardest is a superlative; the relative pronoun after things is left out, so a magician can do describes the things.

introduction.zh: 王子备好了船。杜立德医生把许多药水倒进盆里，让邦波把脸埋进去。等的时间太久了，医生一条腿换一条腿地站着，反复读瓶子上的标签——这一盆东西会弄出什么结果？
introduction.en: The ship is ready. The Doctor pours his medicines into a basin and tells Bumpo to put his face in. The wait is long, and the Doctor shifts from one leg to the other, reading the labels over and over. What will come out of that basin?

sentences: 王子就发了誓，离开去海边准备船。
等他回来，说船已经备好，医生就请达布达布拿一个盆来。
然后他把许多药调进盆里，让邦波把脸浸进去。

hints.zh: 达布达布，医生的鸭子。
hints.en: Dab-Dab, the Doctor's duck.

sentences: 王子俯下身，把脸浸了进去——一直浸到耳朵。
他在里面憋了很久——久到医生显得非常紧张、坐立不安，一会儿用这条腿站，一会儿换那条腿，还去看他调药时用过的那些瓶子，把上面的标签读了一遍又一遍。
牢房里弥漫着一股浓烈的气味，像牛皮纸烧着了的味道。

hints.zh: 坐立不安、烦躁地动来动去。
hints.en: Fidgety: unable to keep still because you are nervous.

hints.zh: 棕色包装纸、牛皮纸；烧起来有股特别的气味。
hints.en: Brown paper, the thick wrapping paper; it has a smell of its own when it burns.

sentences: 最后，王子把脸从盆里抬起来，喘得很厉害。
所有的动物都惊讶地叫了起来。
因为王子的脸已经变得像雪一样白，他那双原本泥色的眼睛，也成了英气十足的灰色！

hints.zh: 泥色的，土褐色的；说他原来的肤色。
hints.en: Mud-coloured: the colour of mud, his old skin colour.

sentences: 约翰·杜立德借给他一面小镜子照自己，他高兴得唱起歌来，在牢房里跳起舞。
可医生让他别为这事弄出这么大动静；医生匆匆合上药袋，然后叫他打开牢门。

hints.zh: 镜子的旧说法，等于 mirror。
hints.en: Looking-glass: an old word for a mirror.

quiz.question: What did the animals see when the Prince lifted his face out of the basin?
options: His face had turned as white as snow
Only his hair had changed colour
Nothing had changed at all

feedback.zh: 原文说他脸白得像雪，原本泥色的眼睛也变成了灰色，所以动物们惊叫起来。
feedback.en: His face had turned as white as snow and his mud-coloured eyes were grey, so the animals cried out.

quiz.question: What was the Doctor doing while the Prince kept his face in the basin?
options: Standing first on one leg and then on the other
Reading a book by the prison window
Mixing a second basin of medicine

feedback.zh: 他紧张得坐立不安，一条腿换一条腿地站，还把用过的瓶子标签读了一遍又一遍。
feedback.en: He was dreadfully fidgety — one leg, then the other — and read the labels on his bottles again and again.

grammar.excerpt: so long that the Doctor seemed to get dreadfully anxious and fidgety

focus.zh: so + 形容词 + that 从句：that 后面说明「久」到什么结果——医生都紧张得坐立不安了。
focus.en: So + adjective + that-clause: the that-clause gives the result — he held it so long that the Doctor grew anxious.

introduction.zh: 邦波抱着镜子舍不得还，医生却说他刮胡子要用。牢门开了，人和动物一起往海边跑；奇怪的是，医生一边跑一边回头，脸上没有多少高兴的样子。他在担心什么？
introduction.en: Bumpo cannot bear to give up the looking-glass, but the Doctor says he needs it to shave. Then the prison door is open and everyone runs for the shore. The Doctor, though, keeps looking back, and his face is not happy. What is he afraid of?

sentences: 邦波求他把镜子留下，因为这是乔利金基王国唯一的一面镜子，他想整天照着自己看。
可医生说他刮胡子要用它。
王子从口袋里掏出一串铜钥匙，打开了那两把大锁。
医生带着所有的动物，尽快往海边跑去；邦波则靠在空牢房的墙上，快活地朝他们的背影笑，他那张大脸在月光下像磨光的象牙一样发亮。

hints.zh: 地牢，城堡或王宫里关人的牢房。
hints.en: A dungeon: the prison room inside a castle or palace.

hints.zh: 象牙；磨光以后会发亮。
hints.en: Ivory: elephant tusk, which shines when it is polished.

sentences: 他们到了海滩，看见波利尼西亚和奇奇在船边的岩石上等着他们。

hints.zh: 奇奇，那只猴子。
hints.en: Chee-Chee, the monkey.

sentences: 「我心里挺为邦波难过，」医生说。
「我怕我用的那种药撑不了多久。
等他早上醒来，多半还是跟以前一样黑——这也是我不愿意把镜子留给他的一个原因。
不过话又说回来，他也可能一直白下去——那种药我以前从没配过。
说实话，它效果这么好，连我自己都吃了一惊。
可我总得想个办法，不是吗？——我总不能给国王擦一辈子厨房。
那厨房脏成那样！——我从牢房窗户里就看得见。——唉，唉！——可怜的邦波！」

hints.zh: 说实话、老实说；用在句首，表示下面说的是真心话。
hints.en: To tell the truth: said before an honest admission.

sentences: 「哦，他当然会明白我们只是跟他开了个玩笑，」鹦鹉说。

quiz.question: Why does the Doctor refuse to leave the looking-glass with Bumpo?
options: He says he needs it to shave with
He says it belongs to the King
He says it is worth a lot of money

feedback.zh: 医生当场给的理由很平常：他刮胡子要用这面镜子。
feedback.en: His reason is a very ordinary one: he needs it to shave with.

quiz.question: What is the Doctor afraid of as they leave the prison?
options: That the medicine will not last and Bumpo will turn black again
That the King's soldiers are running after them
That Bumpo will not keep his promise about the ship

feedback.zh: 他直说「我怕我用的那种药撑不了多久」，还猜想王子早上醒来多半又变回原来的样子。
feedback.en: He says he is afraid the medicine will never last, and thinks Bumpo will most likely be as black as ever by morning.

grammar.excerpt: Bumpo begged that he might keep the looking-glass

focus.zh: begged 后面接 that 从句，用来说明他求的是什么；从句里的 might 让请求听起来更委婉。
focus.en: Begged is followed by a that-clause saying what he asked for; might makes the request softer.

introduction.zh: 到了海边，动物们为邦波的事争了起来：鸭子气得直摇尾巴，狗讲了个不太好听的猜测，医生替王子说了句好话。上船之前，还有一件事没定下来——谁跟医生回帕德尔比，谁留在非洲？
introduction.en: At the shore the animals argue about Bumpo: the duck is angry, the dog makes a rude guess, and the Doctor says a kind word for the Prince. Before they sail, one thing is still open — who will go to Puddleby, and who will stay in Africa?

sentences: 「他们根本没道理把我们关起来，」达布达布气呼呼地摇着尾巴说。
「我们从没害过他们。
他要是又变回黑人，那是他活该！
我希望黑得不能再黑。」

hints.zh: have no business to do 意思是「没有权利、根本不该做某事」。
hints.en: Had no business to lock us up: they had no right to lock us up.

hints.zh: 他活该、他自找的；表示某人受惩罚是应得的。
hints.en: Serve him right: he deserves it.

sentences: 「可这事跟他没关系，」医生说。
「把我们关起来的是他父亲，国王——这不是邦波的错……
我在想，我是不是该回去道个歉——唉，算了——等我回到帕德尔比，给他寄点糖果吧。
谁知道呢？——说不定他真的一直白下去了。」

hints.zh: 帕德尔比，医生的家乡，全名「沼泽边的帕德尔比」。
hints.en: Puddleby, the Doctor's home town, short for Puddleby-on-the-Marsh.

sentences: 「就算他真的一直白着，睡美人也不会要他，」达布达布说。
「我倒觉得他原来的样子更好看。
可不管把他弄成什么颜色，他也只会是个丑样子。」
「不过，他心肠好，」医生说，「当然，有点爱幻想——可心肠是好的。
说到底，『人好看不好看，要看人做的事』嘛。」
「我看这个可怜的傻瓜根本没找到睡美人，」狗吉普说。
「多半是他吻了哪个农夫家的胖老婆——那人正在苹果树下打盹呢。
她被吓着，也不能怪她！
不知道这一回他又要去吻谁。
荒唐事！」

hints.zh: 吉普，医生的狗。
hints.en: Jip, the Doctor's dog.

sentences: 于是「推我拉你」、白鼠、咕咕、达布达布、吉普和猫头鹰图图，跟着医生上了船。
但奇奇、波利尼西亚和鳄鱼留了下来，因为非洲才是它们真正的家，是它们出生的土地。

hints.zh: 图图，医生的猫头鹰。
hints.en: Too-Too, the Doctor's owl.

hints.zh: 「推我拉你」，那只两头动物，一头说话一头吃草。
hints.en: The pushmi-pullyu, the two-headed animal, with a head at each end.

quiz.question: Who does the Doctor say was really to blame for locking them up?
options: The King, Bumpo's father
Bumpo himself
The parrot, Polynesia

feedback.zh: 医生点明：下令关人的是邦波的父亲国王，所以这不是邦波的错。
feedback.en: The Doctor points out that it was the King, Bumpo's father, who had them locked up.

quiz.question: What does Dab-Dab think of the Prince's looks?
options: He looked better the way he was
He is much handsomer now that he is white
He has always been handsome

feedback.zh: 达布达布说「我倒觉得他原来的样子更好看」，还说不管什么颜色他都是丑的。
feedback.en: Dab-Dab says he looked better the way he was, and that he would be ugly in any colour.

grammar.excerpt: It was the King, his father, who had us locked up

focus.zh: had us locked up 是 have + 宾语 + 过去分词：不是国王自己锁门，而是叫人把我们关了起来。
focus.en: Had us locked up is have + object + past participle: someone else did the locking, not the King himself.

introduction.zh: 船离了岸，四面的海又大又空。医生忽然想起：回帕德尔比这一路，没有人替他们带路。就在这时，高高的夜空中传来一阵沙沙的怪声，越来越近——那是风，是雨，还是别的什么？
introduction.en: The ship leaves the shore, and the sea looks huge and empty. Then the Doctor remembers: no one on board can guide them back to Puddleby. Just then a strange rustling comes out of the high night sky, closer and closer. Wind? Rain? Something else?

sentences: 医生站在船上，从船边望过水面。
这时他想起，身边没有人能带他们回帕德尔比。
月光下，茫茫大海显得又大又孤单；他开始担心，等驶到看不见陆地的地方，他们会不会迷路。

hints.zh: 看不见陆地的地方，也就是远离海岸的洋面。
hints.en: Out of sight of land: far from the coast, with no land in view.

sentences: 就在他担心的时候，他们听见高空中有一种奇怪的沙沙声，透过夜色传来。
动物们都停下道别，侧耳倾听。

hints.zh: 低低的沙沙声，像有人贴着耳朵说悄悄话。
hints.en: A whispering noise: a soft, rustling sound, like whispers.

sentences: 那声音越来越响，越来越大。
它好像正在靠近他们——像秋风穿过白杨树的叶子，又像一场极大的雨打在屋顶上。

hints.zh: 白杨树，叶子又薄又密，风一吹就沙沙响。
hints.en: A poplar-tree, whose thin leaves rustle in the wind.

sentences: 吉普把鼻子朝前指着，尾巴伸得笔直，说：
「鸟！——几百万只——飞得很快——就是它！」
于是他们全都抬起头来。
只见成千上万的小鸟像一大群小蚂蚁一样，从月亮前面流过。
不一会儿，整个天空好像都装满了鸟，还有更多的不断飞来——越来越多。
鸟多得一时把整个月亮都遮住了，月亮照不出来，海面变得又暗又黑——就像乌云遮住太阳的时候。

hints.zh: 一大群（飞虫、鸟），密密集集地一起动。
hints.en: A swarm: a very large group of small flying creatures moving together.

quiz.question: What is the Doctor worried about at first?
options: That they will lose their way at sea
That they will run out of food
That the ship is too small for the animals

feedback.zh: 他担心驶出看得见陆地的地方以后会迷路，因为船上没人认识回帕德尔比的路。
feedback.en: He wonders if they will lose their way once they pass out of sight of land — nobody on board knows the way home.

quiz.question: What does Jip say the noise is?
options: Millions of birds flying fast
A storm coming over the sea
The wind in the trees on shore

feedback.zh: 吉普鼻子朝前、尾巴笔直，喊出「鸟！——几百万只——飞得很快」。
feedback.en: With his nose pointing and his tail straight, Jip calls out: birds, millions of them, flying fast.

grammar.excerpt: they heard a strange whispering noise, high in the air, coming through the night

focus.zh: heard + 宾语 + coming：coming 是现在分词，补出声音正从夜空传来，不是句子的谓语。
focus.en: Heard + object + coming: the -ing form shows the noise coming through the night; it is not the main verb.

introduction.zh: 它们落下来了，落在沙滩上、缆绳上，却一片树叶也不碰；蓝翅膀，白胸脯，短腿上长着羽毛。杜立德医生在月光里抬头看着它们，说了一句让人放心的话——这些鸟要往哪里去？
introduction.en: Down they come — on the sands, on the ship's ropes, anywhere but the trees: blue wings, white breasts, short feathered legs. In the moonlight the Doctor speaks to them, and what he says makes everyone feel safe. Where are these birds going?

sentences: 不久，这些鸟都低低地飞下来，掠过水面和地面；上方的夜空又清朗了，月亮照旧亮着。
它们仍旧不叫、不喊、不唱——除了那巨大的羽毛沙沙声，一点声音也没有，这声音此刻比先前更响了。
当它们开始落在沙滩上、船上的缆绳上——到处都落，就是不上树——医生看清了：它们有蓝色的翅膀、白色的胸脯，还有长着羽毛的短短的腿。
它们刚全都找到落脚的地方，忽然，四下里一点声音都没有了——一切都安静下来，一切都静住了。

hints.zh: 掠过、贴着表面飞过；skimming over the water 就是贴着水面飞。
hints.en: Skimming: flying just above the surface, almost touching it.

sentences: 在静静的月光里，约翰·杜立德开口了：
「我一点也没想到我们在非洲待了这么久。
等我们到家，差不多就是夏天了。
因为这些都是往回飞的燕子。
燕子们，谢谢你们等我们。
你们想得真周到。
现在我们不必担心在海上迷路了……
起锚，扬帆！」

hints.zh: 燕子；它们每年秋天成群飞往温暖的地方，春天再飞回来。
hints.en: Swallows: small birds that fly off to warm lands each year and come back in spring.

hints.zh: 这里不是「爱思考」，而是「体贴、替别人着想」。
hints.en: Thoughtful here does not mean “clever”: it means kind and considerate.

hints.zh: 起锚，把锚从水底拉上来，准备开船。
hints.en: Pull up the anchor: lift it out of the water so the ship can sail.

sentences: 船驶到水面上，留下来的奇奇、波利尼西亚和鳄鱼难过极了。
因为他们这辈子从没遇到过像沼泽边的帕德尔比镇约翰·杜立德医生这样让他们喜欢的人。
他们一遍又一遍地向他喊「再见」，之后仍旧站在岩石上，痛哭着挥手，直到船看不见为止。

hints.zh: 哭得很伤心；bitterly 在这里表示痛苦、难受的程度。
hints.en: Crying bitterly: crying hard, in deep sorrow.

quiz.question: What kind of birds are they?
options: Swallows flying back home
Sea-birds from a near island
Birds that escaped from the King's palace

feedback.zh: 医生说出答案：「这些都是往回飞的燕子」，还说自己没想到在非洲待了这么久。
feedback.en: The Doctor names them: these are the swallows going back. He had not known they had been in Africa so long.

quiz.question: Why is the Doctor glad to see the birds?
options: They can show the ship the way home
They will bring food for the animals
They will sing the animals to sleep

feedback.zh: 他说「现在我们不必担心在海上迷路了」，随后就叫人起锚扬帆。
feedback.en: He says they need not be afraid of losing their way on the sea, and then orders the anchor up.

grammar.excerpt: As soon as they had all found a place to sit

focus.zh: as soon as 引导时间从句，意思是「一……就……」；从句用过去完成时，主句的事紧接着发生。
focus.en: As soon as introduces the time clause: the moment they had all found a seat, the next thing happened.
